## About
We're a car repair shop in Miami built around wheel alignment and the work that keeps your car driving straight. Dan, Rick and the team hold a 4.8 rating from 375 Google reviews.
Reviewers mention all kinds of cars coming through, from a Civic to a Huracán, plus a lowered Trailblazer SS and a custom Rolls Royce. One reviewer put it simply: these guys treat every car like it's their own.
We're open weekdays and closed on weekends. Give us a call and we'll walk you through what your car needs and what it will cost before we start.

## Services
- Alignment: Alignments with the tech explaining the adjustments as they go. One reviewer said Rick worked on their alignment and explained it all.
- Adjustable suspension: Lowered trucks, custom builds and fully adjustable suspension are welcome here.
- Brakes: One reviewer said Dan walked them through their alignment adjustments and also checked their brakes.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, the shop is closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you align a lowered car?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in a lowered truck and said the team got it aligned.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Give the shop a call. One reviewer said Dan set up their appointment over the phone.
